text:
ana: SkyForge reached out: they'd like a joint perf/Energy sweep next Tuesday. Focus: watts-per-inference (J/infer), sustained tok/s, and thermal headroom under continuous load. They want a one-pager for marketplace listing and a tech playbook for SI handoff. Can we assemble owners and a minimal run plan?
carlos: I can handle partner comms and marketplace checklist. Need approval flow for using SkyForge logo in any public assets.
suresh: I'll take kernel tuning + telemetry schema. Ask: which GPUs and PDUs? If we can get per-card current clamps that'll help correlate to card rails.
emily: I'll own workloads and metrics. Propose tests: 1) short-chat (avg 64 tokens) 2) long-gen (seq=2048) 3) streaming burst (token-per-second stress). Capture 50 customer prompts + 500 synthetic long seeds.
michael: infra calc: 6 hosts x8 GPUs, 2 full sweeps per day, 2 days -> ~192 GPU-hours (24 GPU-days). Confirm spare capacity and lab slots.
benchbot: Reservation created: lab-resv-5400023456 slot: 2026-04-14T08:00Z -> 2026-04-15T23:00Z. Link: https://infra.redwood/reservations/lab-resv-5400023456
suresh: Telemetry fields (export to Prom): card_power_w, card_current_a, gpu_util_pct, mem_util_pct, soc_temp_c, throttle_flag, fan_rpm, wall_kw. Also record PDUs' per-rack power and ambient_temp.
emily: Workload script snippet for repeatable runs:
```
for phase in short long stream; do
  ./bench_run --model redwood-8q --phase $phase --batch 1,4,8 --seq 64,512,2048 \
    --measure power --out /mnt/bench/skyforge/$phase
done
```
carlos: SI (BrightPath) wants an ops checklist: driver pins, bios knobs, and PCIe lane checks. I'll loop them in.
suresh: Kernel knobs to sweep: tile_size=(64,128,256), prefetch=(on,off), reuse_cache=(true,false). Also try our quant microopt branch vs stock. Expect ~180 combos with batches/sequences.
emily: We'll compute J/infer = (avg_card_power_w * elapsed_s) / total_inferences. Chart ask: x=throughput (tok/s), y=J/infer (lower better). Include thermal headroom as a secondary axis or inset. Keep the public chart simple.
marketingbot: Marketing request: 1-paragraph, 2-line caption, and a single simplified chart by Friday for marketplace tile. Also confirm logo usage and legal clearance.
suresh: Add parity and numerical-check smoke: run 100 fixed seeds across partner branch and our baseline, diff tolerance 1e-4 for logits. Abort big sweep on parity failures.
michael: Note: pin drivers to 555.12 and nv-kernel 6.2.8 per SkyForge validation. If host firmware differs, containerize userland but drivers must match.
benchbot: bench-agent: first job started 2026-04-14T08:12:47Z (job id: b-5400023468).
benchbot: job b-5400023468 completed: 2026-04-14T11:05:33Z. Summary: baseline -> 6.9 tok/J at 1150 tok/s (seq=1024, batch=4, tile=128). Artifacts: /mnt/bench/skyforge/b-5400023468/summary.json
emily: Good baseline. Can someone run `python tools/energy_agg.py /mnt/bench/skyforge/b-5400023468/power.csv --out /tmp/energy-agg.json` and post quick numbers?
suresh: grabbing logs. Starting parity smoke vs SkyForge branch now. If parity ok, we'll kick off kernel sweep.
carlos: Quick legal note: partner requested a quote approved by them before publishing. Ana, want to be the sign-off contact?
nana: (typo not a participant)
nana: ignore
emily: We'll also include a small A/B latency tail plot (p50/p95/p99) for one representative short-chat run. Keeps marketing happy.
suresh: For job orchestration, use `run_sweep --retries 2 --concurrency 8 --timeout 5400`. Store logs under path with naming: skyforge/partner-vs-redwood/{jobid}.
michael: If jobs start failing due to thermal trips, reduce batch sizes and add 2m cool-down between runs. Also record rack inlet temps.
carlos: I'll coordinate BrightPath and request their SI checklist by EOD today. Also will ask Legal for logo approval timeline.
benchbot: update: parity smoke passed for 100 seeds. Kickoff: kernel sweep queued (approx 180 jobs).
suresh: runbook draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/runbooks/skyforge-energy-sweep-v1.md (telemetry, knobs, naming, parity checks).
emily: ETA for chart sketch: tomorrow EOD. Marketing: once we have 3 reps I'll draft the 1-paragraph and caption for review.
carlos: Partner asks for marketplace-friendly artifact: single CSV with representative rows (tok/s, J/infer, seq, batch, knobs). I'll prepare a reducer script.
nana: please remove me from thread (mistap)
carlos: noted.
michael: Action summary: carlos=partner+marketplace, suresh=kernel+telemetry, emily=workloads+charts, ana=partner sign-off + press/legal loop, me=infra ops and retention. Everyone OK? :thumbsup:
